Detect sgRNAs at one or more reference stages

Source: R/qc.R
qc_guide_representation.Rd

Classifies each targeting sgRNA as detected or not at each stage of the screen (e.g. plasmid, T0), and summarises sgRNA loss per gene. Use it to see how much of the library is lost before selection starts.

Usage

qc_guide_representation(
  counts,
  stages,
  ctrl_pattern = "NEG_CTRL",
  min_reads = 30
)

Arguments

counts

Count matrix: data frame with columns sgRNA, Gene and one column of raw counts per sample (see section 'Count matrix').

stages

Named list; each element gives the sample IDs (columns of counts) pooled for that stage, e.g. list(Plasmid = "Plasmid", T0 = c("T0_1", "T0_2", "T0_3")). The order of the list sets the order of stages.

ctrl_pattern

Regular expression matched against the Gene column to identify control sgRNAs (default is "NEG_CTRL", which matches the controls of all libraries shipped with crisprFlow).

min_reads

An sgRNA is detected at a stage if its mean count per sample in that stage is at least min_reads (default is 30).

Value

A list with

guide_summary

one row per sgRNA and stage: sgRNA, Gene, stage, mean_count, detected

gene_summary

one row per gene and stage: n_guides, n_detected, n_lost, frac_lost

threshold

the min_reads used

Pass it to qc_plot_guide_detection and qc_genes_with_lost_guides.

Examples

rep_data <- qc_guide_representation(
  exampleCounts,
  stages = list(Plasmid = "Plasmid", T0 = c("T0_1", "T0_2", "T0_3")))
head(rep_data$gene_summary)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>   stage   Gene   n_guides n_detected n_lost frac_lost
#>   <fct>   <chr>     <int>      <int>  <int>     <dbl>
#> 1 Plasmid AAK1          5          5      0         0
#> 2 Plasmid ABL2          5          5      0         0
#> 3 Plasmid ACTB          5          5      0         0
#> 4 Plasmid ACTR5         5          5      0         0
#> 5 Plasmid ACVR1C        5          5      0         0
#> 6 Plasmid ADH1B         5          5      0         0
